pyUE4Parse, vendored unmodified.

source:   https://github.com/MinshuG/pyUE4Parse
git rev:  88c9434a9c3b57fa8ba1058bd6c20c7f123270ec
licence:  MIT - see licenses/pyUE4Parse-MIT.txt
vendored: 2026-10-11

Pure Python only: the Cython texture extension (Assets/Exports/Textures/
utils.pyx) is deliberately not built. UE4Parse guards that import and falls
back to its Python decoder, which this tool never calls - it parses
MovieScene data and never decodes a texture.

Not patched. Where this tool needs different behaviour from upstream it
monkeypatches at runtime from gameextract.py (the container partition size
and the compression-method spelling) rather than editing these files, so
this copy can be replaced wholesale with a newer upstream checkout.
